encodedContentComparison.conclusion: Later original-form IMG content matches the same-browser PNG encoding of original625. The original file bytes and the two decoded RGBA arrays are not identical.

limits.selectionExplanation: Source writes no selection, text, input or DOM nodes and checks original form/text/ref interactions. This receipt does not contain a new [61,14] selection projection.
limits.visibilityExplanation: visible() is declared but not called. renderedCard fields draw an already loaded IMG into an offscreen canvas at naturalWidth/naturalHeight; they do not sample WindowServer or CSS-composited pixels.

pixelComparisonReportedByOriginalBrowser.algorithmScope: Both PNGs use browser createImageBitmap default color conversion/premultiplication and full natural-size offscreen sRGB RGBA8 canvases. Every overlapping pixel/channel is compared. Equal dimensions leave no pixels outside that comparison.
